title: PatternMinedEvent
description: Carried on patterns.mined; Pattern Miner output only. Deliberately carries NO rootCauseAlarmType, lifecycle, or patternId field (RCA and lifecycle belong to the Pattern Manager).

trailId.description: Trail scope the pattern was mined from (top-level field).

sampleAlarms.description: A bounded, representative sample of the real member alarms this pattern was mined from (for operator review / XAI). Optional; absent or empty when no sample was captured. Bounded by a producer-side cap (K).

alarmId.description: Unique alarm identifier of the member alarm.

alarmType.description: Canonical alarm-type token of the member alarm.

raisedAt.description: When the member alarm was raised (ISO-8601 UTC).

managedObjectId.description: Managed object the member alarm was raised on; canonical '<objectType>:<id>' scheme.

perceivedSeverity.description: X.733 severity of the member alarm.

timing.description: Inter-arrival timing statistics for the sequence.

sourceWindowId.description: Identifies the transaction window this pattern was mined from.

snapshotId.description: Topology snapshot version in scope when mining ran.

domain.description: the domain this snapshot/event belongs to (e.g. `core-ip`); a snapshot belongs to exactly one domain. Optional for backward-compat; consumers default to the single MVP domain when absent.

codebookVersion.description: Codebook version in scope when mining ran.

anchorScenarioId.description: The Codebook fault-origin scenario this pattern was anchored to during domain-knowledge anchoring; null/absent means the cascade was unexplained (no confident scenario match). Optional for backward-compat.
